name: Valsze Research Profiles for SINTA
author: valsze

sections.description:
Valsze Research Profiles for SINTA displays public author profile information from SINTA, including the profile header, scores, metrics, and publications.

This plugin is an unofficial tool from Valsze and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by SINTA or its operators.

It includes:

  • Top-level admin menu: Research Profiles
  • Dynamic Gutenberg block
  • Elementor widget
  • WordPress transient caching
  • Frontend source tabs for Scopus, Garuda, RAMA, Researches, Community Services, IPRs, and Books

This plugin reads public SINTA profile pages because SINTA does not currently provide a public API for this use case. If SINTA changes its page markup, the parser may need an update.

External services

This plugin connects to the public SINTA (Science and Technology Index) website to fetch public author profile, score, metric, and publication data. This connection is required for the plugin to display SINTA profile information in the block, Elementor widget, and frontend output.

The plugin sends the configured numeric SINTA Author ID to https://sinta.kemdiktisaintek.go.id/authors/profile/ when a profile is displayed and the requested profile/source is not already available in the WordPress transient cache. When visitors switch publication source tabs, the selected source name, such as Scopus, Garuda, RAMA, Researches, Community Services, IPRs, or Books, may also be sent as a request parameter. Like any normal HTTP request, the site server’s IP address and user agent may be visible to the SINTA service.

This service is provided by SINTA / Kementerian Pendidikan Tinggi, Sains, dan Teknologi Republik Indonesia. Service website: https://sinta.kemdiktisaintek.go.id/. Service FAQ: https://sinta.kemdiktisaintek.go.id/home/faq. I could not identify separate public terms of service or privacy policy pages for this specific SINTA service; if SINTA publishes dedicated terms or privacy URLs, they should be reviewed directly by site administrators before using this plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the valsze-research-profiles-for-sinta folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open the Research Profiles menu in the WordPress admin sidebar.
  4. Enter the numeric SINTA Author ID.
  5. Insert the “Research Profile for SINTA” block or Elementor widget.
sections.changelog:
1.0.10

  • Security: validate SINTA Author IDs before building remote requests.
  • Security: sign frontend AJAX profile requests so arbitrary IDs cannot be forged.
  • Security: harden HTML parsing against external network entity loading.

1.0.9

  • Censor Rupiah amounts in source-specific fields such as the Researches amount badge.

1.0.8

  • Censor Rupiah amounts in publication metadata, including Researches funding values.

1.0.7

  • Fix source tabs staying disabled after a successful AJAX tab switch.

1.0.6

  • Switch frontend source tabs to AJAX buttons to avoid one-page theme anchor navigation.

1.0.5

  • Harden profile header layout against one-page theme CSS.
  • Prevent profile names from breaking into overly narrow columns.

1.0.4

  • Remove Google Scholar from SINTA publication source tabs.

1.0.3

  • Add frontend tabs so readers can switch publication sources.
  • Rename source setting to Default Publication Tab.

1.0.2

  • Center the profile header content.
  • Improve responsive layout for mobile screens.

1.0.1

  • Move settings to a top-level Research Profiles admin menu.
  • Improve frontend colors for dark mode themes.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
